findings.title: Call to non-existent no-arg `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` fails to compile
findings.body: `UsernameForm.authenticate` calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but the superclass `UsernamePasswordForm` only defines `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)` (line 160). Because no zero-argument overload exists in `UsernameForm` or its supertypes, this file will not compile.

findings.title: `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled` requires `user != null`, breaking passkey login when user is not yet identified
findings.body: `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)` returns `webauthnAuth != null && webauthnAuth.isPasskeysEnabled() && user != null`. On initial login (and in `challenge(...)` when `context.getUser()` is `null`), `context.getUser()` is `null`, so `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser())` evaluates to `false` at lines 115 and 137. As a result, `webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context)` is never called during normal unauthenticated login challenges, preventing the WebAuthn conditional UI attributes and form from being rendered on the initial login page.
